description.value: A standard Taco Bell franchise location in Delta, BC serving Tex-Mex fast food including tacos, burritos, and the Crunchwrap Supreme. The restaurant offers both dine-in and drive-thru service, as well as online ordering and delivery. It is one of several Taco Bell locations in the Metro Vancouver area.
